plaatsen.tekst: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench
